shellCommands.command: rm -f books.json && (node server.mjs &>/tmp/server.log & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid) && sleep 1 && \ LOC=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -d 'title=The+Dispossessed&author=Ursula+K.+Le+Guin¬es=Anarres+%3C3' http://localhost:3000/books) && \ echo "redirected to: $LOC" && \ curl -s "http://localhost:3000${LOC#http://localhost}" | grep -E 'h2|author|notes' && \ curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3000${LOC#http://localhost}/finish" -o /dev/null && \ curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -A2 'Finished' && \ kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid) && sleep 0.3 && \ (node server.mjs &>/tmp/server2.log & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid) && sleep 1 && \ echo "--- after restart ---" && curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep 'Dispossessed' && \ kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid) && cat books.json

kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid) 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'node server.mjs' 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; cat /tmp/server.log; (node server.mjs &>/tmp/server.log &) && sleep 1 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/book/d5764b020d | head -40
pkill -f 'node server.mjs'; sleep 0.5; nohup node server.mjs > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 & sleep 1; curl -s http://localhost:3000/book/d5764b020d | head -40; echo "---LOG---"; cat /tmp/server.log

sleep 1 echo "=== home (empty check / existing book) ===" curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'Dispossessed|Nothing' || true echo "=== book detail page ===" curl -s http://localhost:3000/book/d5764b020d | grep -E '

|by |notes|Mark finished' echo "=== mark finished (from detail page) ===" curl -s -X POST -H 'Referer: http://localhost:3000/book/d5764b020d' -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n' http://localhost:3000/book/d5764b020d/finish echo "=== home after finish ===" curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -B1 -A4 'Finished

' echo "=== 404 for bad id ===" curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/book/ffffffffff echo "=== XSS escaping check ===" curl -s -o /dev/null -d 'title=&author=X' -w '%{redirect_url}\n' http://localhost:3000/books

cat books.json && node server.mjs & SRV=$!; sleep 1; echo "--- after restart ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -c 'book/'; kill $SRV 2>/dev/null; rm -f books.json /tmp/srv.pid /tmp/server.log /tmp/server2.log
